rawScenePlan.title: Price Roll Disturbance
rawScenePlan.event: In the central Kaufhaus atrium the creature sits centered beneath the store's hanging signage. A tentacle flicks a suspended, automatic pricing dispenser on a promotional podium; it whirs and vomits a continuous adhesive price-tape that unspools across the polished floor, snagging on an escalator step and yanking a row of ceiling catalog placards loose. The placards slide down the escalator like sleds, scattering brochures.
rawScenePlan.monsterPresence: Head and upper body visible, face intent; multiple tentacles actively manipulate the dispenser and press against the escalator rail.
rawScenePlan.consequence: A long sticky price-tape snakes from the podium, stuck over an escalator step and trailing into aisle space; several catalog placards lie torn on the escalator.
rawScenePlan.nextHook: sticky price tape across central escalator

rawScenePlan.consequence: A partially torn borough map panel hangs ajar with a neon 'Neukölln' insert visible and a blinking red alarm/strobe above it.

rawScenePlan.cameraCue: After the panel flips, camera quickly dollies in and tilts to frame the exposed 'Neukölln' insert and the blinking alarm, partially concealing the creature behind the map frame to emphasize the discovered panel.

rawScenePlan.title: Reuterkiez Steam
